root_causes.invariant: A prior attempt record remains immutable while a fresh attempt has one collision-free canonical receipt address.
root_causes.evidence: SWU-CAL-001's existing fixed terminal path contains a valid blocking receipt for attempt WP-CAL-TEN-L0/SWU-CAL-001/20260808T173559Z-a1. The same fixed path is the sole execution output and route expected receipt, so a fresh pass would overwrite it or collide before write.

root_causes.invariant: Every passing closeout emits exactly one unique successor projection, while the frozen full frontier remains unexpanded.
root_causes.evidence: CLOSEOUT-CONTRACT requires successor projection, but validate-admission.py rejected every frontier other than [SWU-CAL-001] and left EXECUTION-ENTRY-VALIDATION.json stale after any closeout.

minimal_repair.terminal_lineage: Replace each fixed terminal output with an immutable per-SWU receipt root and <attempt-leaf>.json template. SWU-CAL-001 binds the exact historical blocking receipt as legacy evidence; new receipts self-address their attempt-derived immutable path. SWU-CAL-010 retains its four witness outputs as well as the receipt root.
minimal_repair.continuity: Make admission validation accept either one valid current successor or the final empty complete projection, require a deterministic projection record in every closeout receipt, and regenerate EXECUTION-ENTRY-VALIDATION.json with every closeout.
minimal_repair.fast_entry: Treat the route expected receipt as a declared scope, so an attempt-specific terminal file is allowed only below the declared immutable receipt root. Exact-file routes continue to work unchanged.
minimal_repair.owner_boundary: No L0 adapter is proposed. The generic runner's post-commit next action is owner-hooks-not-implemented by design; Task Session owns the canonical L0 terminal receipt and Invoke Refresh owns closeout/continuity. Implementing those owner actions inside this sidecar would exceed a governance-only repair.

required_revalidation_before_any_product: Apply this exact candidate only after renewed owner acceptance; regenerate the acceptance inventory, plan semantic digest, WPRA v2 input, and independent Work Pack Readiness Audit result from staged bytes.

Run py_compile, candidate admission validation, legacy receipt validation, and the full native governance-runner suite against the actual staged bytes; then synchronize the generated task-session package and prove canonical/generated parity.

For each SWU, validate the exact staged material bytes, emit and validate its immutable attempt receipt, then have Invoke Refresh validate the exact closeout and successor projection before a new Task Session request.
Re-run all L0 product validations only after their admitted staged bytes exist.
remaining_pre_product_boundary: The candidate is not applied. The next allowed action is owner review and renewed acceptance of this exact patch; only then may Invoke Refresh create new acceptance-bound planning evidence. Decision Gate, Task Session, and all product writes remain blocked until that regenerated readiness chain passes.
